verdict.rationale: Consensus's own docs claim a literature-review feature to "search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence." They also document per-paper PICO extraction, study-design classification, uniform filters (study type, year, journal) and Deep Search across many studies. However, nothing documents a systematic workflow with user-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria applied consistently across a paper set, or structured extraction tables. Missing for 10: user-defined screening criteria applied consistently across papers, custom extraction fields/tables at scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria

citations.quote: Search, screen, extract, and synthesize evidence faster—while keeping full transparency and scholarly rigor.
Extracted population, intervention, comparator, and outcome (PICO) where applicable
Filters allow narrowing by study type (RCT, meta-analysis, systematic review, observational), publication year, journal, open-access status, and discipline.
Deep Searches (more comprehensive Lit Reviews across many studies)
